Data safety: spacer transactions set only the plugin meta plus addToHistory false and never change the doc, so Tiptap update/onEdit/SaveQueue never fire; saves and exports read getJSON, no code serialises view.dom; Pagination is in Writer editorExtensions, not documentExtensions, so the shared schema, import validation, exports and the Rust allowlist never see a spacer; print hides .page-spacer. Seven corrections: (1) drift met by test, every page start within 1 px by offsetTop and drawn at 1240 and real 585 split (rect/zoom with offsetTop guard instead of pure offsetTop, justified by the 1.4 px integer drift); (2) native-gate.py interleaves runs, records p50/p95/max sync and paint plus six caret flags and exits nonzero; (3) paginate defers while view.composing, re-runs on compositionend and the next update; (4) split filter present (defensive); (5) margin click to page end, tested; (6) heading-with-next defined, single pass, unit-tested, no loop; (7) limitations.md bullet matches the decision. native-smoke phase 1 cannot hang: wait() is bounded (500 x 40 ms) and the new paper-height condition holds once page count reaches 2.

REQUIRED BEFORE MORNING STEP 2 (smoke.rs bakes the scripts in with include_str, so patch before building the P2 binary): tests/native-screens.js writing-pages capture dispatches Escape on document, but the More popover closes only via its own React onKeyDown (ToolbarControls.tsx:117) or a real pointerdown; at the 1240 native window the view toggle is under More, so the writing-pages PNG (and possibly later captures) will show the More popover open. Fix: dispatch the Escape on the Page view button or re-click More formatting after toggling. pages-probe in native-smoke.js also leaves More open (it refocuses the editor before typing, so the instrument still works; close it anyway).

Morning watch items: the gate pass criteria use sync latency only, which is measured before the pagination rAF re-measure; also compare p2 paint p50/p95/max against base in the same interleaved runs. WebKit offsetTop under CSS zoom is unverified: if it is zoomed, the 1.5 px guard falls back to the wrong value and footnote tops (offsetWithin, no guard) misassign pages in a narrow pane; check page starts and footnote placement numerically in the 585 pane, not only by eye. Non-blocking: print keeps the paged min-height on .editor-paper (pre-existing shape); a spacer computed at exactly 0 px would let margins collapse through it (rare).

T147 (P2 vertical pagination) by agent-1733. Status CLAIMED. Native gate NOT RUN (screen locked: CGSSessionScreenIsLocked=1 at about 04:20 EDT); no WebKit performance or caret claim.

WHAT CHANGED
- NEW src/editor/pagination.ts: Tiptap extension Pagination (PluginKey pagination). Widget decorations div.page-spacer (contenteditable false, aria-hidden, side -1, stable key, data-page/index/split) before the first block of each new page. Pure planPages(blocks, geometry) does the arithmetic; computeBoundaries measures. Exports Pagination, paginationKey, paginate(view, fresh), planPages, offsetWithin. Spacer transactions: addToHistory false, no doc change.
- Correction 1 (drift): blocks measured in unzoomed layout px from the writing surface: rect offset divided by the paper's exact CSS zoom (snapped to zoom or 1 from the rendered/layout width ratio), guarded by offsetTop (falls back to offsetTop if they differ by more than 1.5 px). Pure offsetTop alone was tried first and drifted 1.4 px by page 34-42 (whole-pixel rounding builds into spacer heights); now every page start is within 1 px at 1240 and in a real 585 px split pane (zoom about 0.69), both by offsetTop and by drawn position.
- Correction 3 (IME): paginate does nothing while view.composing; it re-runs on compositionend and on the next update after composing ends.
- Correction 4 (split): the document capture scroll listener ignores scrollers that do not contain this Writer's viewport. The page number is computed from this Writer's unzoomed viewport box, so it is also immune by construction (doctored copy without the filter stays green: defensive, not load-bearing).
- Correction 5: mousedown on a spacer: above the page's lower paper edge -> end of that page; in the gap or below -> start of the next page (Shift extends).
- Correction 6 (heading-with-next, defined): a run of headings moves with the block after it. If the headings and that block together are taller than a page, the block stays directly under its headings and runs across the gap (no stranded heading). A page holding only headings above the block keeps them together. A page's first block never moves. Single pass, no retries, so no loop (unit tests).
- Correction 7: docs/limitations.md new bullet: whole-block rule; only a block taller than a page (or heading+next block taller than a page) runs across the gap; same footnote reserve on every page; narrow pane scaled not reflowed; exports keep their own pagination. This follows coordinator decision P2 paragraph placement at page foot, pending the owner's morning check; flipping to straddle-when-it-does-not-fit is one condition in planPages.
- src/editor/editor.css: .is-paged block replaced (vertical repeating gradient, width = page width, min-height from --page-count, writing-surface position relative + display flow-root, no columns); .page-spacer hidden outside page view and in print; print drops columns. Names .is-paged, .editor-paper, --page-count, --page-width kept.
- src/Writer.tsx (E1/E3 hunks kept): Pagination in editorExtensions (not documentExtensions; extensions.ts untouched); page count from plugin state on transaction; fresh paginate after layout/settings change; fitScale (ResizeObserver, clamp 0.25-1) sets zoom and --page-scale in page view; document capture scroll -> current page; viewport onScroll removed; page footnotes positioned by top per page.
- src/editor/useFootnoteLayout.ts: reference tops (offsetWithin, unzoomed), vertical pitch, starts from the applied reserve, paginate after a reserve change. footnoteLayout.ts: assignPages params renamed (page pitch), maths unchanged, plus a vertical unit case. formatting.ts: countPages and its unit case removed (unused).
- Tests: NEW tests/pages.spec.ts (5 tests); NEW src/editor/pagination.test.ts (10); features.spec page-view test now asserts vertical model (paper taller than 2 pages, no sideways scroll, paragraph one rect); performance.spec NEW page-view latency test (90-page section, same 25/50 ms budget); native-smoke.js phase 1 waits for vertical pagination (old getClientRects>1 wait would hang), diagnostics record paper height and spacers, NEW pages-probe phase (latency keydown->update and keydown->second frame p50/p95/max, caret via WebKit Selection.modify, gap/margin click); native-screens.js + scripts/native-screens.py NEW writing-pages capture. footnotes.spec and accessibility.spec unchanged (pass).

LIMITS: Chromium only; WebKit unmeasured (latency, caret across contenteditable=false spacer, rects under zoom, IME). Footnote reserve is uniform. Measure cost grows with block count (about 3 ms per 700 blocks in the spike). A block taller than a page draws over the gap. Two consecutive page breaks give a blank page.

DESIGN DOC: Pages -- Page view stacks pages vertically and scrolls down only. One editor flow; the pagination plugin (src/editor/pagination.ts) inserts a non-editable .page-spacer before the first block of each new page, so the caret, selection and undo work across pages. A block that does not fit moves whole to the next page (up to one block of blank space at a page foot); headings move with the next block; a page break starts a page; only a block (or heading plus block) taller than a page runs across the gap. Footnotes sit at the foot of their page with one shared reserve. A pane narrower than the page scales the paper with CSS zoom (--page-scale), never sideways scroll. Clicking a page's bottom margin puts the caret at that page's end; clicking the gap puts it at the next page's start. Spacers wait for an input-method composition to finish. Page view and exports use different engines.
